notes.title: Still Ridge Prologue Update - Steam Scream Fest 2023
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween, ghouls and ghosts! I have a big update to the demo of Still Ridge. Sadly I wasn't able to include a brand new demo of the first chapter but if you haven't yet completed the prologue there's good reason to dive back into dream world.

Did you know I post development updates and videos at https://www.youtube.com/@justenbrown

[h1]Controls Updated[/h1]
[list]
[*]Pressing Tab highlights all interactable objects on screen for a few seconds. Makes it easier to see what you're doing.
[*]Press full stop (.) to skip cutscenes. Perfect for replayability!
[*]Steam.NET has been implemented. The game should now be integrated with Steam's in-game menu.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a tutorial message overlaying another tutorial message
[*]Omar always runs during the APC segment for better control
[*]Added a box collider around the truck during the APC segment
[*]Using the lighter on the river occurs instantly instead of walking a set distance to enhance readability of the player's action
[*]Fixed an issue where Hypnos' name wasn't changed from ???
[*]Fixed issue where backing out of options menu in-game would break the pause menu
[*]Fixed strange stuttering when title appears
[*]Updated in-game cursor to use built-in Unity object instead of system software cursor. This should improve compatibility with different inputs in the future that emulate mouse axis. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the previous scene's music didn't stop during the transition to the chase scene.
[*]The camera from the river to the warehouse properly crossfades
[*]Fixed an issue where NPCs didn't set their neck transformation correctly leading to characters staring at their feet.
[*]Fixed an issue where the player didn't uncross their arms after examining a photo
[*]Fixed an issue where the player didn't stop looking at a character sitting down in the office
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Some small updates were made to the demo.

-Some grammar and spelling issues fixed
-One of the paintings in the office had an incorrectly named hotspot
-Volume adjust options changed from sliders to colored bars for clarity
-An instance where an incorrect animation was playing has been fixed
-Content warning updated to express a wartime setting for players sensitive to that subject
-Custom links to store page and Twitter have been added to title screen
-Framerate would reset to 60 each scene. Framerate now remembers chosen option

notes.title: Still Ridge Prologue Released!
notes.notes: The demo/opening chapter to the supernatural point-and-click adventure game Still Ridge is out now. Experience the 60-90 minute long beginning to Omar's story that takes him to the mysterious town in the West Virginia mountains.
